name: Ghee (Clarified Butter)
siboNotes: Excellent fat choice for SIBO as it's pure fat with no fermentable carbohydrates. The clarification process removes milk proteins and lactose.
preparationTips: Store at room temperature for up to 3 months or refrigerate for longer storage
Use for high-heat cooking as it has a higher smoke point than regular butter
Add to cooked vegetables or rice for rich flavor without FODMAPs
Can be made at home by slowly heating butter until milk solids separate
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K
Contains butyric acid which may support gut health
High smoke point makes it stable for cooking
